scheme_name: Centrally-Sponsored Scheme Of Pre-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Caste Students Studying In Classes 9th & 10th
other_conditions: Applicant must be a regular full‑time student
Must be studying in Class 9th or Class 10th
Must be enrolled in a government school or a school recognized by the government, CBSE or State Board of Secondary Education
Applicant must be domiciled in the state/UT to which the scholarship is awarded
Scholarship is available for one year only
benefits_summary: Monthly scholarship of ₹225 for day scholars or ₹525 for hostellers, plus an annual book grant of ₹750/₹1000 and additional allowances for students with disabilities.
